text: @goodandready/dsh-image-gen 是面向 DSH Web 的图像生成与视觉处理插件，通过工具、/image 命令和设置界面接入会话。它可调用 FAL、Replicate、OpenAI 兼容接口、Gemini、Seedream 或本地 ComfyUI 等后端生成图像，并提供图片编辑、变体、质量检查、背景移除、放大、矢量化和拼图等工具；可选工具组还覆盖设计与前端素材工作流。适合需要在 DSH 对话中创建和调整视觉素材的用户。按所选后端配置对应凭据或本地服务；订阅后端和本地后端是可选路径。

@goodandready/dsh-image-gen adds image generation and editing to DSH Web. Choose a remote provider or local ComfyUI. Tools create images, edit variations, inspect quality, remove backgrounds, upscale, vectorize, and build comparison grids. Configure credentials for the selected provider.
想让 DSH 根据文字提示生成图片
在聊天里编辑一张已有图片或做局部重绘
给商品图去背景并输出透明 PNG
把图片放大后保存到工作区
检查生成图片是否模糊或有明显瑕疵
比较两张图片的像素差异
用多个图片模型生成并比较结果
从图片提取网页设计色彩素材
Generate an image from a text prompt in my DSH conversation.
Remove a picture background and return a transparent PNG.
Can I edit or inpaint part of an image with a prompt?
Help me compare image model outputs side by side.
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「生成图片」：generate_image 根据文字提示生成图片，可设置尺寸、比例、种子和变体数量；结果保存到工作区并显示在会话中。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「编辑图片」：edit_image 根据文字说明修改来源图片，支持指定图片路径或附件，也可传入遮罩进行局部编辑。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「生成变体」：vary_image 基于来源图生成变化版本，可调整变化强度，用于探索不同视觉结果。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「检查质量」：inspect_image_quality 检查图片清晰度和画面变化，并可根据预期元素返回评分、通过状态和说明。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「移除背景」：remove_background 调用图像后端移除来源图背景，返回透明 PNG，并保存为文件和会话附件。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「放大图片」：upscale_image 对来源图片执行放大处理，可指定输出文件名并获取处理后的图片结果。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「矢量化」：vectorize_image 将位图转换为 SVG 矢量图，便于将图形用于可缩放的设计素材。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「融合图片」：blend_images 将多张来源图作为参考进行融合，生成新的组合图像。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「拼接图片」：assemble_image_grid 将多张图片拼接成并排、网格或纵向对比图，适合展示不同生成结果。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「提取设计令牌」：extract_design_tokens 从图片提取设计系统相关的颜色和样式令牌，帮助从视觉参考整理界面素材。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「生成渐变样式」：image_to_css_gradient 根据图片中的色彩生成可用于网页样式的 CSS 渐变代码。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「画布工具」：canvas_state 查看图像工作台画布内容，view_canvas 将画布选择整理为会话可用的图像附件。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「替换图片文字」：replace_image_text 识别图片中的文字区域并执行文本替换工作流，适合更新海报或图片标签。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「草图生成」：sketch_to_image 将草图作为视觉输入，结合提示词生成完整图像。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「模型对比」：compare_models_matrix 将同一提示提交给多个图像模型，并整理生成结果供横向比较。
@goodandready/dsh-image-gen 的功能「斜杠命令」：/image 接收提示词和尺寸、比例、后端、风格或种子等参数，可直接触发图片生成。

@goodandready/dsh-image-gen README · 🚀 Updates v0.10.18: Speed Acceleration & Quality Hardening (#222)：* **Parallel Batch & Pack Generation**: Multi-variation requests (`count > 1`, `prompts` array) and `generate_image_pack` multi-ratio workflows now execute concurrently with a concurrency limit (`concurrency: 3`) via `asyncPool`, reducing generation wait times by up to **3x**.
* **Zero-Delay Initial Polling**: Eliminated artificial initial delay in `pollStatus` and queue runners (Fal.ai, ComfyUI), inspecting generation status immediately on first attempt and shaving 1–1.5s off fast generative workflows.
* **Sub-Millisecond L1 In-Memory Cache**: Built-in 32-entry in-memory LRU cache atop disk cache L2 provides instantaneous (< 0.1 ms) cache hits without synchronous disk I/O.
* **Fast-Fail Quota Detection**: Added classification for HTTP 402 (Payment Required) and exhausted account quota/credits in `isFatalClientError`, enabling immediate, clean fallback transitions without fruitless retry loops.
* **Expanded Test Suite**: Added `test/batch5-speed-quality.test.mjs`, bringing total test coverage to **136 automated unit tests (100% pass)**.

It equips autonomous agents with an extensible set of tools for image generation, transformation, background removal, upscaling, vectorization, multi-reference blending, and quality inspection across 8 generative backends.

@goodandready/dsh-image-gen README · 🛡️ Reliability, Performance & Quality (v0.10.0)：* **Exponential Backoff with Jitter**: Adaptive polling for FAL, Replicate, and ComfyUI queues protects against HTTP 429 rate limits.
* **Error Classification in Fallback Cascade**: Client-side errors (Content Policy, 400 Bad Request, NSFW) fail fast without wasting API credits on other providers.
* **Deterministic Hash Caching**: Exact matches of prompt, model, and seed return instantly from local storage with zero API expense.
* **ComfyUI & Automatic1111 Drag-and-Drop**: Metadata is packed into PNG `Parameters` chunks in standard format.
* **Dimension Snapping**: Automatic normalization to multiples of 64 guarantees VAE bucket compatibility.
* **Enhanced Style Presets**: Built-in styles include tailor-made negative prompts and optimal guidance scale settings.
